content: MK reports that, unlike Ṣāʾin al-Dīn, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Bisṭāmī names Fażl Allāh explicitly and denounces him as a satanic extremist in pursuit of worldly ends, and takes care to call the practitioners of intellectual lettrism ḥarfiyya or ahl al-ḥarf, as opposed to the messianic, incarnationist ḥurufiyya; MK follows Bisṭāmī in calling Fażl Allāh's followers Hurufis and Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's circle lettrists.
